items.title: As Wardogs Season 3 looms, Bulkhead claims to have built 'one of the world's most sophisticated anti-cheat systems', assisted by 'machine learning and AI'
items.excerpt: Bulkhead says Wardogs' new anti-cheat was built by analysing 187 million hours of gameplay with machine learning and AI; it arrives with Season 3 on November 12 alongside a new urban map.
items.rationale: Freshest item (11-08): a shipping studio's ML anti-cheat trained on 187M hours of play, live Nov 12 — new deployment, distinct from the EA Javelin interview.

items.title: [기획 | 게임사 AI 전환의 현주소 ④]… 크래프톤, 결과보다 AI 협업 과정 평가
items.excerpt: 크래프톤은 2027 채용연계형 인턴십 6개 직군의 AI 역량평가에 자체 개발한 '코파 프로브(Cofa-Probe)'를 쓴다. 지원자가 업무 에이전트와 협업하는 과정을 소스코드·프롬프트·검증 기록까지 자동 수집해 기술·의도·인지 관리 세 축으로 평가한다.
items.rationale: Replacement for the CozyBlanket Pro cross-section dup: a game publisher's in-house tool that grades how candidates work WITH AI agents (code, prompts, verification logs) across 6 job tracks — concrete, new, and directly relevant to game devs entering the industry.

items.title: Ubisoft scales AI coding agents to 4,000+ developers with Unity Gateway
items.excerpt: Databricks customer story: Ubisoft rolled out AI coding agents to more than 4,000 developers through Unity Gateway (Databricks' AI gateway), with centralised model access, governance and usage tracking.
items.rationale: Concrete AAA-scale deployment (4,000+ devs) with governance details; vendor case study, so enrichment must verify figures and note 'Unity Gateway' is Databricks' product, not Unity Technologies'.

items.title: 신작 연기 반복한 넷마블, 내년 13종 출시 자신…AI로 개발 속도 높인다
items.excerpt: 넷마블이 내년 신작 13종 출시를 AI 기반 개발·운영 체계로 뒷받침한다. 기획부터 번역·녹음·그래픽 제작, 품질 검증·운영 자동화까지 반복 업무에 AI를 쓴다.
items.rationale: Korean major publisher commits its 13-title 2027 slate to an AI pipeline spanning planning, localisation, voice, art and QA — a new studio-wide plan, not the earlier Netmarble Nexus Kiro case.

items.title: The AI posting war is heating up: 'Please, leave me behind,' says artist who got into it with Epic CEO Tim Sweeney on X
items.excerpt: Asset artist Kenney urged artists not to cave to pressure to use generative AI; Epic CEO Tim Sweeney replied 'This is bullshit, Kenney', and the clash split developers and players on X.
items.rationale: New public clash (11-06) between a widely used free-asset artist and Epic's CEO over pressure on artists to adopt gen AI — a fresh event, not a rehash of the EULA or Steam-disclosure stories.
